changelog:
Initial release of telegram-replies skill.

- Guides how to ghostwrite personalized outbound Telegram messages as a real person, not a bot.
- Emphasizes batching replies per chat, avoiding burst messages and repeated templates to bypass Telegram's anti-spam systems.
- Explains tone, role selection (owner, secretary, etc.), and when to use fixed templates versus freeform responses.
- Details Telegram's behavioral, content, and account-age-based anti-spam checks.
- Includes instructions on checking and respecting account restrictions via @SpamBot.
summary: Use when authoring an outbound Telegram message as a real person's own account (ghostwriting a DM or reply once it's already decided that a reply is warranted and to whom) — choosing tone and wording, batching multiple unread messages into one reply, avoiding Telegram's own behavioral anti-spam / co
